author: muzimu217
changelog: 0.2.0：新增 image_info（免解码读取格式/像素尺寸/大小，纯 JS 头部解析，支持 PNG/GIF/JPEG/WEBP）与 list_images（列出工作区图片清单，带大小、上限 200 条）两个只读工具——agent 可先发现图片再精读。0.1.0：read_image（校验存在/格式/大小 → pi.fs.readRange 读取 → images 字段多模态回传；workspace 内零提示读取、范围外宿主逐次授权；planSafeActions 声明使 Plan/Goal 模式下可用）。

agentTools.description: Read ONE local image file and attach it to the conversation as a multimodal image block, so a vision-capable model can actually see it (the built-in Read tool is text-only and cannot do this). Use it whenever the user references a screenshot, mockup, diagram, photo or any image file by path and wants the agent to look at it. Supports png, jpg, jpeg, webp and gif up to 10MB. Images inside the open workspace read without prompts; paths outside the workspace trigger a one-time user grant. Returns a short text summary plus the attached image — never echo base64 image data into your reply.
agentTools.name: read_image

path.description: Image file path — absolute, or relative to the open workspace.

agentTools.description: Inspect ONE local image's metadata WITHOUT loading it into the conversation: format (by magic bytes), pixel dimensions and file size. Use it to check an image before reading it visually (read_image), or to answer size/dimension questions cheaply. Same path rules and supported formats as read_image.
agentTools.name: image_info

path.description: Image file path — absolute, or relative to the open workspace.

agentTools.description: List image files in the open workspace (png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif) with sizes, so the agent can discover which images exist before reading any. Optionally scope to a workspace-relative directory. Read-only, results capped at 200 entries.
agentTools.name: list_images

dir.description: Optional workspace-relative directory to scope the listing.

description: 给 agent 的视觉工具集：read_image 读取本地图片（png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif，≤10MB）经工具结果 images 块回传，视觉模型直接看图分析；image_info 免解码读取格式/尺寸/大小；list_images 列出工作区图片清单——补上内置 Read 仅限文本的能力缺口。工作区内零提示读取；范围外路径由宿主逐次授权。

en.name: Vision Kit
en.description: A vision toolkit for the agent: read_image reads a local image (png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif, up to 10MB) and returns it as a multimodal block so vision models can analyze it directly; image_info reports format/dimensions/size without decoding; list_images enumerates workspace images. Closes the gap left by the text-only built-in Read. Workspace images read without prompts; paths outside fall back to per-path user grants.
en.safetyNotes: Read-only. No network egress, no writes or deletes, nothing executed from image content. File access goes exclusively through the host's scoped fs API: workspace images per the declared glob scope, anything else requires an explicit user grant per path; the host's secret-file denylist always applies. Image bytes are attached to the current agent conversation as multimodal input only.

zh-CN.name: Vision Kit 读图工具

zh-CN.safetyNotes: 纯只读插件：不声明任何出网域名、不写不删、不执行图片内容。文件访问全部经宿主 fs 策略 API：工作区内按声明的 glob 范围读取，范围外每条路径都需用户明确授权；宿主的密钥文件拒绝清单始终生效。图片字节仅作为多模态输入附加到当前 agent 会话。

name: Vision Kit 读图工具
safetyNotes: 纯只读插件：不声明任何出网域名、不写不删、不执行图片内容。文件访问全部经宿主 fs 策略 API：工作区内按声明的 glob 范围读取，范围外每条路径都需用户明确授权；宿主的密钥文件拒绝清单（.env、密钥、.git 等）始终生效。图片字节仅作为多模态输入附加到当前 agent 会话，不上传到任何其他位置。
